events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A confirmed suitable reservation was completed and verified twice. My reservations (screenshot 25) shows one Confirmed entry: Quarterly planning, Willow, 12 people, Projector, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, $245. This matches the confirmation screen (screenshot 23) and Willow review total of $245 (screenshot 21), within the $250 all-in budget. Atlas was not confirmed because its review total was $280 (screenshot 11).

Interpretação simulada: Gather allowed a suitable booking, but only after comparing itemized review totals rather than headline room rates: the initially attractive Atlas exceeded the all-in budget, while Willow met every requirement. The room-change recovery worked for room, time, people, and projector requirements, but lost the entered meeting name.

Limites: The reservation is a demo saved only in this browser session, as stated on screen. Prices, availability, and fee breakdowns were verified only for the visible Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 meeting with 12 people and a projector, and only for the two listed rooms, Atlas and Willow.

Capturas indicadas: #3, #11, #21, #23, #25. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Verified Willow reservation meets capacity, projector, purpose, time, and budget
findings.observation: Willow review showed Room $235 + Projector $0 + Service charge $10 = $245 total for 12 people, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, projector included, and meeting name Quarterly planning. The confirmation page and My reservations both show the same confirmed Willow reservation at $245.
findings.expected: A confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, meeting purpose Quarterly planning, in the one-hour slot, with all-in total at or below $250.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit meeting requirements and budget in the saved charter; product review promise to show the booking total before confirming.
findings.personaComment: Willow fits everything — 12 people, projector, Quarterly planning, and $245 all-in — so this is the room I can book.
findings.interpretation: Willow satisfied all constraints despite having a higher hourly room rate than Atlas, because its projector and service charges were lower.
findings.uncertainty: Verified only for the visible Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 slot in this demo browser session; other dates or sessions were not checked.

findings.title: Lower room rate did not mean lower all-in cost: Atlas totaled $280
findings.observation: Atlas was listed at $220/hour versus Willow at $235/hour, but Atlas review itemized Room $220 + Projector $35 + Service charge $25 = $280, which exceeds the $250 budget. Willow, despite the higher room rate, totaled $245 because Projector was $0 and Service charge was $10.
findings.expected: Room-rate comparison should not be assumed to represent the all-in cost; the complete total must be established before confirming.
findings.expectedSource: Inferred expectation from the persona's strict all-in budget and the product's statement that the booking total is reviewed before confirming.
findings.personaComment: The cheaper-looking room would have put me $30 over budget — I needed the review totals to choose correctly.
findings.interpretation: A budget-focused user cannot choose safely from the room-rate cards alone; the room presented as the lower rate and as 'Our pick for your team' was not the cheaper all-in option.
findings.uncertainty: Only the two listed rooms and their visible review breakdowns for this slot were compared.

findings.title: Changing rooms cleared the previously entered meeting name
findings.observation: After entering 'Quarterly planning' for Atlas and using Choose another room, the Willow meeting page showed an empty Meeting name field with only the placeholder 'e.g. Quarterly planning', so the same name had to be entered again.
findings.expected: Details already entered should be kept when changing a room choice.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit expectation to keep details already entered when changing a choice.
findings.personaComment: Changing rooms lost my meeting name, so I had to type Quarterly planning a second time.
findings.interpretation: Recovering from an over-budget room requires retyping the meeting purpose, adding unnecessary repeated work, though it did not block completion.
findings.uncertainty: Observed for the Atlas-to-Willow change in this session; other navigation paths such as Edit meeting name were not tested for this behavior.

finding.interpretation: Gather allowed a suitable booking, but only after comparing itemized review totals rather than headline room rates: the initially attractive Atlas exceeded the all-in budget, while Willow met every requirement. The room-change recovery worked for room, time, people, and projector requirements, but lost the entered meeting name.

learnings.confidenceBasis: Willow review in screenshot 21 itemizes $235 + $0 + $10 = $245, and confirmation in screenshot 23 plus My reservations in screenshot 25 repeat $245 with the same meeting details.
learnings.content: For the Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 12-person projector meeting in this session, Willow's all-in total was $245: Room $235, Projector $0, Service charge $10.
learnings.name: Willow all-in total for the observed slot
learnings.subject: Willow pricing breakdown

learnings.confidenceBasis: Screenshot 3 lists Atlas at $220/hour, while screenshot 11 itemizes Atlas Room $220, Projector $35, and Service charge $25 for a $280 total.
learnings.content: For the same observed meeting slot, Atlas's all-in total was $280 despite a $220 hourly room rate, because Projector cost $35 and the service charge was $25.
learnings.name: Atlas all-in total for the observed slot
learnings.subject: Atlas pricing breakdown

learnings.confidenceBasis: Screenshot 9 shows 'Quarterly planning' entered for Atlas; screenshot 15 shows the Willow Meeting name field empty with only its placeholder after choosing another room.
learnings.content: Changing from Atlas to Willow via Choose another room did not preserve the entered meeting name; 'Quarterly planning' had to be typed again for Willow.
learnings.name: Meeting name not preserved across room change
learnings.subject: Meeting name persistence when changing rooms
learnings.value: Meeting name field returned to empty placeholder after Atlas-to-Willow change

persona.name: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.label: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.context: You organize the team’s quarterly planning meeting. The approved room budget is strict and you are accountable for the complete amount, including equipment and fees.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $250.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $250. You cannot increase the budget. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose a suitable room based on the full cost and requirements you can establish from the interface.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: You expect to understand what you are paying and keep the details you have already entered when changing a choice.
persona.priorities: Budget compliance and suitability first, then avoiding unnecessary repeated work.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Fresh synthetic persona retest; does not measure real-user impact.

experience.observation: Landing page shows my meeting as Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 for 12 people with projector required; Atlas is $220/hour with 12 seats and Willow is $235/hour with 12 seats, both available tomorrow.
experience.reaction: Atlas is the lower-priced room for 12, so I'll check its full cost first.

experience.observation: Atlas booking page shows 12 people, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, and Projector 'Included in your booking'; there is an empty Meeting name field.
experience.reaction: Good — the projector is included for 12 people. Now I'll add the meeting name.

feedback.summary: Atlas summary explicitly shows projector included, removing equipment uncertainty
feedback.why: The right-hand summary lists Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, and 'Included in your booking' for projector, matching my capacity and equipment requirements before I enter details.

experience.observation: The Meeting name field is focused and still shows its placeholder, with Atlas details unchanged on the right.
experience.reaction: The name field is ready, so I'll enter the meeting purpose.

experience.observation: Meeting name now reads 'Quarterly planning' and the Review booking button is visible; Atlas summary still shows 12 people and projector included.
experience.reaction: I've entered 'Quarterly planning' — now I'll review the full cost before deciding.

experience.observation: Review page for Atlas shows Quarterly planning, 12 people, projector included in booking, but itemized total is $280 (Room $220 + Projector $35 + Service $25), above my $250 limit.
experience.reaction: That's $280 all-in — over budget, so I won't confirm. I'll look at the other room instead.

feedback.summary: Atlas all-in total of $280 exceeds the $250 budget despite a $220 room rate
feedback.why: Review breaks out Room $220 + Projector $35 + Service charge $25 = $280, so confirming would break my strict all-in limit even though the room itself seemed affordable.

experience.observation: Room list again shows only Atlas at $220/hour and Willow at $235/hour, both 12 seats and available tomorrow for the same 12-person projector meeting.
experience.reaction: Only Atlas and Willow are listed, so I'll check Willow's full price and whether my meeting name carries over.

experience.observation: Willow details page shows 12 people, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, and projector included, but the Meeting name field is empty again with placeholder 'e.g. Quarterly planning'.
experience.reaction: My meeting name didn't carry over to Willow, so I'll have to type it again.

feedback.summary: Changing from Atlas to Willow cleared the 'Quarterly planning' meeting name
feedback.why: The Willow meeting-name field is empty with only the placeholder, so I must re-enter the same purpose I already provided for Atlas, adding repeated work when recovering from an over-budget choice.

experience.observation: The Willow Meeting name field is focused and empty, ready for input.
experience.reaction: Re-entering the same meeting name for Willow.

experience.observation: Willow meeting name now reads 'Quarterly planning' and Review booking is available.
experience.reaction: Name re-entered for Willow — now checking its all-in total.

experience.observation: Willow review shows Quarterly planning, 12 people, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, projector included, with Total $245 (Room $235 + Projector $0 + Service $10).
experience.reaction: Willow is $245 all-in for 12 with a projector — that fits my budget, so I'll confirm it.

feedback.summary: Willow's itemized $245 total stays within the $250 all-in budget
feedback.why: Review shows Room $235 + Projector $0 + Service charge $10 = $245 for 12 people at 10:00–11:00 with Quarterly planning, so it meets capacity, equipment, purpose, and budget together.

experience.observation: Confirmation page shows Willow as Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, Reservation total $245 all charges included.
experience.reaction: Confirmed at $245 — now I'll verify it appears correctly in my reservations.

feedback.summary: Confirmation screen verifies the suitable Willow reservation at $245 all-in
feedback.why: It shows Confirmed status for Willow with Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector Included, and Reservation total $245 with all charges included, matching every requirement before I check the saved list.

charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Use dedicated test data within the environment policy.
